invariants.rationale: A valid commit should require a non-null instantTime to uniquely identify the commit.
Committing is meaningful only if there is at least one WriteStatus to commit.
A non-empty commitActionType is necessary to specify the type of commit operation.
The map of partitions to replaced file ids is required for maintaining commit metadata.
The Option wrapper for the pre-commit function should be non-null, even if it may be Option.empty().
